chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 574: The Rout at the Final Barrier – Ji Ning Slaughters the Seamless Gate Army
chapter_meta_description: The Realm War ends in a brutal rout as Ji Ning's Karmic Punishment Deity crushes the Seamless Gate. The Three Realms' major powers react to his fourth level Heartforce breakthrough.
og_title: Desolate Era: The Realm War Ends in Bloody Rout
og_description: The Seamless Gate is annihilated. Ji Ning's true power as a fourth level Heartforce master is revealed to all of heaven and earth.
twitter_title: Realm War Over! Ji Ning Goes Full God-Mode
twitter_description: The Crimsonbright Realmverse wins big. The major powers of the Three Realms react to Ji Ning's shocking Heartforce breakthrough.

lore_anchors.definition: Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals. Ji Ning's version is uniquely powerful due to his Heartforce mastery.

The third of the Three Sovereigns of Humanity; a figure of supreme power and wisdom who taught humanity agriculture and herbal medicine. In Desolate Era, his involvement in a Realm War is a monumental event.
A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness, virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort. The Evergreen Sword Immortal piloted one.
The personal domain of the Lord of All Demons, a secure location where the most powerful and secret puppets for the Seamless Gate are crafted. The Wuxiao Celestial Immortal observes from here.
A furious, immensely powerful being of the Seamless Gate who crafted the Daofather Puppet. He is enraged at the loss, blaming the pilot rather than the puppet's design.

A tier of metaphysical power that places a Celestial Immortal on par with the pinnacle of Pure Yang True Immortals and top-tier divine archers, granting them Daofather-threshold combat capability in formation combat.
